context.transcript:
Welcome to this broadcast of Karla's Kitchen! ® Today I'd
like to introduce a healthy breakfast food called overnight
oatmeal. It's a kind of cold cereal that can be prepared the
night before you plan to eat it. All you have to do is combine
oats and milk and soak them in the refrigerator overnight.
Then, in the morning, you can add fruit, nuts, or spices.
I especially like that this recipe has very little sugar. The
detailed recipe's on my Web site. ®Now, I'd like to introduce
today's guest, Carrie Nelson, author of the cookbook Healthy
Options. ®We'll talk to her about overnight oatmeal as well
Z000
as her other favorite breakfast dishes.
